backend: NativeTransformerBackend over ReferenceCpuBackend (host CPU, FP32 arithmetic, bf16 KV pool)
model: reference test weights (TransformerWeights::reference_test_weights): 3 layers, hidden 32, 4 heads, 2 kv heads, head_dim 8, vocab 97; synthetic, not a real model

definitions.cold-prefill: second_turn: turn 1 then turn 2 = turn-1 prompt + turn-1 output + suffix, store off; turn 2 prefills everything
definitions.decode_tokens_per_s: sum over requests of (tokens - 1) divided by the summed per-round window from the earliest first token to the last finish
definitions.p50_us/p95_us: request latency: submit_work call to the step that emitted the Finished event; nearest-rank percentiles over every measured request of the row
definitions.peak_allocated_bytes: kv_pool_allocated_bytes: the KV pool allocation, constant after start (ADR 0003 section 10)
definitions.peak_holder_bytes: peak kv_pool_holder_blocks times the block stride, sampled after every step; inside the pool, not added to it
definitions.peak_rss_bytes: VmHWM of the bench process after writing 5 to /proc/self/clear_refs at the start of the row
definitions.peak_staging_bytes: kv_host_tail_scratch_bytes (one block stride) for modes that use the store, 0 otherwise; buffered reads use the page cache, reported as cache_state
definitions.queue_depth: store I/O operations the storage worker may dispatch at once (WorkerConfig.dispatch_depth); 0 when the mode uses no store
definitions.resident-only: single_turn: one request per conversation (prompt, turn2_max_tokens), store off; nothing ever leaves memory
definitions.restore-from-page-cache: second_turn with the host store on: turn 1 parks, turn 2 restores the stored prefix (objects written moments before, no cache drop) and prefills the rest; every measured request must commit a restore
definitions.store bounds: restore-from-page-cache sets AIEN_KV_STORE_MAX_RESTORE_OPS and AIEN_KV_STORE_MAX_PARK_OPS to concurrency x (chunks of the longest turn + 1), never below the defaults 48 and 16 (run::store_op_bounds); with the defaults, 8 conversations finishing in one step overflow the park class and their parks are refused QueueFull
definitions.timing: token and finish times are taken when the bench drains the completion channel after each spine step (step granularity)
definitions.ttft_p50_us/ttft_p95_us: submit_work call to the end of the step that emitted the request's first token

rows.reason: a device read needs the page cache dropped (root: /proc/sys/vm/drop_caches) and verified empty with mincore (ADR 0003 section 15.1); this harness never uses sudo, and O_DIRECT reads are cut X1/X2
